build_ReplkNet_backbone: build a RepLKNet backbone model with a specified architecture like 31B or 31L
create_ReparamLargeKernelConv: create a reparameterizable large kernel convolution module with optional small kernel shortcut
merge_kernel_deployment: merge the training-mode kernels into a single deployment-mode convolution for inference
create_ConvFFN: create a convolutional feed-forward network block with 1x1 convolutions and GELU activation
freeze_ReplkNet_stages: freeze early stages of the RepLKNet backbone to prevent gradient updates during training
